name: Sasakura Miu
source: A female student at Migouji Academy. She is one year older than Sumi and Yunoka. Miu is a member of science club and thus always wears a white coat for dignity. She has a secret regarding her bloodline, and because of this very secret, she becomes involved with Sumi and Yunoka.
